SELECT d.fiscal_period, count(*) n, count(distinct f.receipt_id||'-'||f.line_no) dist_lines, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.net_amount) net,
 sum(round(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2)) calc_gross,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date <> CAST(f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) date_mismatch,
 min(f.etl_loaded_at), max(f.etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT o.status, o.fulfilment_type, o.login_state, count(*) orders, sum(o.order_total_gross) total, count(distinct o.web_order_id) d
FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.order_ts_utc >= '2024-07-28' AND o.order_ts_utc < '2024-10-29' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_period, coalesce(o.status,'NO ORDER') status, count(*) lines, count(distinct f.receipt_id) orders, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(o.order_total_gross)/count(*)*0 x
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, count(*) orders, sum(o.order_total_gross) total, sum(CASE WHEN o.status='cancelled' THEN o.order_total_gross ELSE 0 END) cancelled,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS DATE) <> CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tzshift
FROM fact_web_order o JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=CAST(o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS DATE)
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
